scope: 73 lexical Tinker/Shaman passages plus MagneticWall semantic supplement:74 exact passages;3 frozen shared-rule paragraphs. Other157 future lifecycle candidates stay separate.

classRecords.text: Wisdom is the class ability. Choose Elemental Affinity automatically at 1: Fire, Ice, Air or Earth. Spellcasting/RP remain separate from Totem objects and flasks. Totem capacity 1, rises 2 at 13; any third replaces one of your existing totems. A totem is a visible Tiny magical object: AC 12+PB, HP 2 L, immobile, immune to poison/psychic/conditions, vulnerable to ordinary weapon and other damage. At 0 HP its aura ends. A new totem appears within 30 ft; cannot occupy a creature's space, serve as a bridge, trap a creature without a save or move through walls.

Totem Casting is Action 2 RP, duration 3 of your turns, 15 ft aura. Choose Flame, Stone, Frost, Spirit or Renewal. Benefits require an ally/target in the aura, maximum 3 creatures benefiting per pulse/round chosen by you. Flame adds 1 fire to an ally's first direct weapon hit per round; on critical that target Burns 1d4 next turn. Stone reduces damage by 1 and gives enemies-1 to STR checks to shove. Frost: enemy first entering/starting each round makes CON save or Speed-10 ft until end its turn. Spirit: first necrotic/hex damage per target per round adds 1. Renewal: on start and each of next 2 turns with Bonus Action+1 RP maintenance, up to 3 allies regain 2 HP. Thus Renewal total cost 4 RP for 3 pulses; no free healing on entry. All totems share one concentration burden; losing it ends all. Other concentration effects replace them. Non-Renewal auras need no Bonus Action upkeep. Multiple same-name/stat auras do not stack.

On your turn you may spend Bonus Action to move one totem up to 15 ft along unobstructed ground, remaining within 60 ft. This competes with healing maintenance, companion commands and advanced flasks. Moving an aura over a creature cannot trigger its once/round effect repeatedly. Totem destruction creates no resource return. Once per round, the first ordinary spell cast while inside your own active totem aura generates 1 less Dissonance, minimum 0; no RP reduction.

Choose Fire/Ice/Air/Earth bonuses through affinity card; Ember/Cold/Shock damage are fire/cold/lightning, Earth uses bludgeoning. Summoned elemental spirits use one standard companion each, maximum one normally; Elemental Chorus expressly summons a package of 4 but all share one Bonus Action command and a printed combined pulse. Companions cannot generate RP, trigger flask refunds or create corpse/kill farms.

Bloodcaller at Hero 10 transforms permanently into Hagraven, with the player choosing this class path and its stated loss of ordinary Shaman spellcasting. It does NOT lose its RP reservoir: printed Hagraven/Totem techniques still pay RP, but it cannot cast ordinary Shaman spells or advanced magical flasks. It retains prior totem/technique selections. The change is a class choice, not permission for involuntary player-character conversion; ancestry identity and player control remain. At long rest it can prepare mundane flasks only if Base Flask Use is known.

card.name: Totem Casting
card.rangeAndTarget: One totem within 30 ft with 15 ft aura
card.effect: Place one Flame/Stone/Frost/Spirit/Renewal totem using the engine's exact profile. All your totems share concentration. Respect 3 creature aura/pulse limit; same-stat bonuses do not stack. Replacing a totem ends it without refund.

source.originalText: Totem Casting: Place a totem that creates an aura effect for 3 rounds.

card.name: Spirit Shock
card.effect: Target makes DEX save: S d8 affinity damage, half on success. Affinity rider applies once; this printed technique is not an ordinary spell, cannot Overcast and does not generate a flask or totem.

source.originalText: Spirit Shock: Channel elemental energy into a damaging burst.

card.name: Extended Totem Duration
card.cost: 0; full upkeep for extra Renewal pulse
card.effect: Totems last 1 extra turn. Renewal may have a fourth pulse only if you pay Bonus Action+1 RP on that turn; no fifth pulse and no automatic free healing. Concentration still required.

source.originalText: Extended Totem Duration: Totems last for an additional round.

card.name: Spirit Cache
card.rangeAndTarget: One flask/to-tem effect you directly used
card.effect: Store its profile, not an active copy. On a later turn use normal Action/Bonus Action and pay all RP and a new flask unit or full totem cost to repeat it. Add 1d6 to one numerical damage/heal amount; no copy of refund/limited use.

source.originalText: Spirit Cache: Store one flask or totem effect to recast later (once per encounter).

card.name: Totem Pulse
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 creatures inside newly placed non-healing totem
card.effect: On placement pay 1 RP: allies gain M temporary HP OR enemies make DEX save for S affinity damage, half on success. No immediate second Renewal healing pulse, no repeat from moving the totem.

source.originalText: Totem Pulse: Totems create an immediate area effect when placed (level 6).

card.name: Spirit Saturation
card.effect: Waive its 2 RP placement cost once. Still use Action, concentration, capacity and any added costs. Cannot create a healing totem or be cached/refunded to generate more free casts.

source.originalText: Spirit Saturation: Gain one free totem cast per combat (level 9).

card.name: Elemental Channeling
card.effect: Embody affinity: gain+10 ft Speed and once/turn add 1d4 affinity damage to a weapon hit. Fire/cold/lightning/bludgeoning by affinity. This concentration replaces your totem burden, so it is a tactical alternative.

source.originalText: Elemental Channeling: Temporarily embody your chosen element, gaining related benefits.

card.name: Ancestral Guardian
card.effect: A guardian prevents S d8+M damage, minimum 0. It then vanishes and creates no companion action, corpse or refund. Cannot prevent sacrifice/trauma or redirect prevented damage into another trigger.

source.originalText: Ancestral Guardian: Summon a protective spirit that intercepts damage meant for you.

card.name: Elemental Surge
card.effect: Choose one: aura radius+5 ft OR numerical flat benefit improves by 1. Renewal instead adds M HP to its next paid pulse, once, without adding a pulse. Same-name/stat stacking rules remain.

source.originalText: Elemental Surge: Enhance a totem's effect for one round.

card.name: Echo Totem
card.rangeAndTarget: Adjacent empty space within 5 ft of newly placed totem
card.effect: Create a weak echo anchor of that totem. It counts toward capacity; if no space in capacity, cannot create it. Its radius 10 ft and numerical bonuses/healing are half, rounded down. Shared concentration/upkeep and same-name nonstacking prevent double healing.

source.originalText: Echo Totem: Automatically cast a second, weaker totem when placing your primary totem.

card.name: Elemental Harmony
card.effect: Add class level to its maximum/current HP on creation and 1 turn duration, maximum 4 turns for class summons. Cannot extend once/day Chorus beyond 4 turns or restore an existing creature's lost HP.

source.originalText: Elemental Harmony: Your elemental summons gain increased duration and health.

card.name: Spiritual Resonance
card.rangeAndTarget: Two of your active totems within 10 ft of one another
card.effect: Their aura radii increase 5 ft. No extra targets or extra pulses and overlapping same-name benefits do not stack. One totem and its echo still use normal capacity.

source.originalText: Spiritual Resonance: Totems affect a larger area when placed near each other.

card.name: Summon Ice Wisp
card.rangeAndTarget: One spirit in empty space within 30 ft
card.effect: Summon standard Ice Wisp with fly 30 ft. Commanded attack deals cold; on hit target STR save or Speed 0 until end its next turn. No whole-turn freezing, bonus independent spells or multiple companion attacks.

source.originalText: Summon Ice Wisp: Call forth a spirit of frost that can snare and freeze enemies.

card.name: Summon Airling
card.effect: Summon standard Airling with fly 40 ft. Commanded attack deals lightning; on hit target CON save or loses Reactions until end its next turn. Failure by 10 also Stunned, subject to the shared hard-denial guard across all the Shaman’s features. Companion Stun counts as the Shaman’s denial; if the target already suffered that denial this encounter, only damage and Reaction loss resolve. One shared companion command.

source.originalText: Summon Airling: Conjure an air elemental that stuns enemies and deals lightning damage.

card.name: Summon Cinderflame
card.effect: Summon standard Cinderflame. Commanded hit deals fire plus Burn 1d4 next target turn. On destruction only (not dismissal), up to 3 enemies within 5 ft make DEX save for S d4 fire, half. Explosion creates no further death/resource triggers.

source.originalText: Summon Cinderflame: Create a fire spirit that applies burning damage over time and explodes on death.

card.name: Summon Stonekin
card.effect: Summon standard Stonekin. Command chooses bludgeoning attack with STR save or Prone on hit, OR gives up to 3 adjacent allies reduction 2 until start next turn. No simultaneous attack and protection command.

source.originalText: Summon Stonekin: Manifest an earth elemental that can root enemies and grant damage reduction to allies.

card.name: Elemental Chorus
card.rangeAndTarget: Four spirits in 10 ft-radius zone within 30 ft
card.effect: Summon a single Chorus package: four visible spirits share HP 4 L, AC 12+PB, immobile. Bonus Action command pulses up to 3 enemies: DEX save S d6 chosen affinity damage half; one failed target Speed-10 ft until end next turn. Four spirits do not make four separate attacks.

source.originalText: Elemental Chorus: Ultimate ability that summons all four elemental types around a zone for massive combined effect.

card.name: Divining Totem
card.rangeAndTarget: One divining totem within 30 ft; observed enemy in aura
card.effect: Each own-turn start choose one visible enemy in 15 ft aura. First ally attack against it before your next turn gains+1 to hit; first attack it makes has-1. Predicts immediate intent, not guaranteed future actions; totem has ordinary object stats.

source.originalText: Divining Totem: Place a special totem that reveals enemy actions before they occur (one target per round).

card.name: Omen Loop
card.cost: Normal RP+2 RP; fresh flask if required; 1 long-rest use
card.rangeAndTarget: Your own qualifying effect used within previous 2 turns
card.effect: Repeat one non-Finale, non-resource-restoring class flask/totem effect with normal targets and full costs. It replaces the current Action; cannot repeat another repeat, regain per-rest uses or exceed totem capacity. If effect required a flask, consume one now.

source.originalText: Omen Loop: Ultimate ability that repeats a spell, flask, or totem cast from two turns ago (once per encounter).

card.name: Hagraven Form
card.effect: Become Hagraven: retain player control/mental stats, light-armor use and ordinary movement; claws are finesse 1d6 slashing, darkvision 60 ft and poison resistance. Lose ordinary Shaman spellcasting/advanced magical flasks; retain RP for printed techniques and totems. No free flight or hidden monster stat block.

source.originalText: Hagraven Form: Your body transforms into a twisted, avian-humanoid hybrid with natural weapons and resistances.

card.name: Blood Feast
card.rangeAndTarget: Self at start regular turn; hostile bleeding creature within 10 ft
card.effect: Pay 1 RP to regain M HP. Bleeding allies, summons or staged captives cannot qualify. No healing while Downed; secondary heal creates no damage/resource triggers.

source.originalText: Blood Feast: Heal when enemies near you are bleeding.

card.name: Blight Totem
card.rangeAndTarget: Totem within 30 ft; 15 ft aura affecting all creatures
card.effect: HP healing received inside aura is halved, rounding down, including allies and you. Nonstacking with another healing reduction; temporary HP unaffected. This totem has standard object stats and grants no free damage/healing.

source.originalText: Blight Totem: Place a corrupted totem that reduces all healing in its area by 50%.

card.name: Elder Spirit Accord — new Hero capstone
card.effect: When starting Elemental Chorus, Omen Loop or Bloodroot Trail, reduce its RP cost by 3, minimum 1, and add M to one damage/healing roll from that use. You must know that ability and still spend its own limited use. If you do not know it, instead reduce one known Hero technique's RP cost by 3, minimum 1. No extra duration, flask, totem, command or repeated cast.

classRecords.text: Intelligence governs class DC/M, device attacks use PB+INT; Dexterity governs personal ranged weapons. Hit Die d8, light armor, shortbows/crossbows/simple weapons, tinkers tools and alchemist supplies. Technology is fictional equipment. Ordinary Tinker spells use RP/Dissonance; mundane bombs/devices with printed RP fuel costs are class techniques and do not separately count as spell casts.

At 1 automatically own one Anacite Drone: AC 13+INT modifier, HP 5+INT modifier+class level (minimum 1), flight 30 ft, ranged bolt 60 ft attack PB+INT for 1d6 piercing. Bonus Action commands one move and one attack or named module action; otherwise it Dodges and may follow you. On bolt hit roll d4; on 4 target CON save or cannot take Reactions through end next turn (Shock, no automatic Stun). All drones/turrets/scraplings share ONE damaging action per Bonus Action command per regular turn unless a card explicitly supplies a priced extra attack. No autonomous barrage. Drone is a construct, not immune to all conditions; poison/psychic immunity, no charm. Carry/retract it in 1 minute; no pocket extra world or passenger flight.

A destroyed drone remains 0 HP until repaired for 1 RP and 10 minutes with tools to half HP, once/short rest, or rebuilt during long rest to full. Ordinary repairing does not recharge devices, grant organic healing or trigger destruction bonuses. At 13 Dual Drone Protocols automatically chooses on each long rest either 2 basic drones each with one module, or one drone with 2 distinct modules. Still one command budget. Never more than 2 drones.

At 5 automatically gain one module slot; change module during long rest. Offensive: Burn Injector first bolt hit/turn causes 1d4 fire next 2 target turns; Poison Vents d4=4 on hit CON save or-1 attack rolls until end next turn; Concussive Bolt d4=4 on hit CON save or Stunned until end next turn, once/target/encounter shared denial guard and 1/short-rest successful Stun. Defensive: Target Taunter command action once/encounter WIS save one foe 30 ft or disadvantage attacking others until end next turn; Energy Shield command gives adjacent ally+2 AC until start next turn; Smoke Cloud command once/encounter creates 5 ft radius opaque smoke centered drone until start next turn. Support: Ammo Dispenser adjacent allies first ranged hit/turn+1 damage; Target Scanner command mark 1 visible foe 60 ft first ally attack before start next turn+1 hit; Tether Grappler command once/encounter pulls 1 willing ally 15 ft within 30 ft without opportunity attacks along open route.

Advanced bomb profiles replace basic rider: Thermobaric fire pushes 5 ft on failed STR save after damage; Cryo cold on failed DEX also Speed 0 until end next turn and d2=2 ignores 1 flat DR against this bomb; Shock lightning CON instead DEX, failure prevents verbal spellcasting until end next turn (construct instead loses Reactions), shared hard-denial guard; Glue no damage, 15 ft square difficult terrain 3 rounds and entering/starting DEX save or Speed-15 ft until end turn, once per creature/round. Overload Core destroys one commanded drone within 30 ft as part Action bomb, DEX save 2d6 lightning and no Reactions until end next turn on failure, half damage on success. Consumes stock/allowance; no further destruction proc.

Deployable slots start 1 at 6, 2 at 13, 3 at 17, separate from drone cap. Deploy Action 2 RP within 15 ft, fixed ground, AC 12+PB HP 2 L, duration 3 rounds, concentration not required; destroyed do not refund fuel. All share command budget. Sentry and Net require their cards. Additional engine profiles unlocked 6: Rocket Tower commanded attack 60 ft target DEX save S d6 fire/half success to up to 2 creatures within 5 ft, maximum 3 shots; Decoy Dummy one foe 30 ft WIS save when deployed or disadvantage on next attack against others, destruction S fire to one adjacent enemy no chain; Blast Wall 10-by 5 ft blocks LOS and movement, climb cost 10 ft. Net Trap one enemy entry STR save or Restrained, end turn repeat/Action escape DC, 3 round max then ends. One only fires when commanded except nonattack trap/decoy trigger; command budget limits damaging triggers too.

Base 1–2, Mechanist Arch 3–9, then Artificer/Techsmith/Warmachine Hero 10–20. Upgrade Slot 5 is automatic; Sentry and Net minimum 6, Remote Detonation 9. There is no source automatic Arch capstone. Mech Overdrive 20 is automatic: once/long rest when deploying choose one device whose duration becomes encounter end (maximum 1 minute), still command dependent, slot limited and destructible. No infinite pulses: healing effects keep original pulse cap and all per-use costs remain. Protected magic interface: once per short rest, as a Bonus Action route up to 2 current Dissonance into one of your active devices within 30 ft. Reduce Dissonance by that amount; the device is disabled and cannot move, attack, emit an aura or trigger effects until repaired or your next completed short rest. Its duration keeps ticking. Repair with an Action and 1 RP using Field Repair, or with 10 minutes and 1 RP using tinkers tools. No RP is created and no Refrain counter resets.

card.name: Mechanical Aptitude
card.effect: Advantage on checks to understand, repair or disable mechanisms. Requires appropriate access and tools; no automatic control of enemy constructs.

source.originalText: Mechanical Aptitude: Gain advantage on checks to understand, repair, or disable mechanical devices.

card.name: Explosive Handling
card.effect: Throw a known prepared bomb as Bonus Action instead of Action. Removes ordinary accidental misfire, not Warmachine risk or enemy defenses. Cannot command a device with the same Bonus Action.

source.originalText: Explosive Handling: Throw bombs as a bonus action without risk of misfire.

card.name: Quick Fingers
card.effect: Open unlocked latch, operate simple switch or retrieve a carried gadget. Does not activate damaging/healing devices, disarm a trap, reload every weapon or add another Bonus Action.

source.originalText: Quick Fingers: Perform device activation and manipulation actions with increased speed.

card.name: Deploy Anacite Drone
card.effect: Drone is automatic class engine. Selecting this card instead upgrades deployment to Bonus Action and permits 5 ft free initial placement. No free attacks, repair or extra drone.

source.originalText: Deploy Anacite Drone: Summon a mechanical companion that attacks with ranged bolts (1d6 damage + 25% chance to shock).

card.name: Field Repair
card.effect: Restore S d8+M HP, up to maximum, to functional damaged machine. Cannot revive destroyed objects, heal organic allies, reset duration or recharge limited uses. If the target is disabled by the Tinker’s protected Dissonance-routing feature, Field Repair also clears that disabled state. It does not reset duration, recharge, ammunition or per-rest uses.

source.originalText: Field Repair: Quickly fix a damaged mechanical device or construct.

card.name: Analyze Weakness
card.effect: Identify one visibly demonstrated damage resistance. Your next bomb/device damage against it ignores 2 flat DR, not resistance/immunity. No invented weakness or automatic secret knowledge.

source.originalText: Analyze Weakness: Study a target to identify vulnerabilities to specific damage types.

card.name: Jury-rig
card.effect: Choose+1 first attack roll/turn or+5 ft device movement. One modification per item, no stack. Does not change weapon category, spell function, summon limit or command budget.

source.originalText: Jury-rig: Temporarily modify a device or weapon to perform a different function.

card.name: Enhanced Drone Control
card.effect: Gain+1 attack roll and can follow simple move/dodge commands while within 120 ft. Attacks still require your Bonus Action and line of effect; no independent turn.

source.originalText: Enhanced Drone Control: Your Anacite Drone gains improved targeting and responsiveness.

card.name: Pet Upgrade Slot
card.effect: Choose one of 9 bounded modules in engine. This automatic unlock is not a selected skill. At 13 use Dual Drone Protocols, still shared command budget.

source.originalText: Pet Upgrade Slot: Modify your drone with an Offensive, Defensive, or Support module (level 5).

card.name: Deployable Expertise
card.effect: Gain M maximum/initial HP and+1 AC. Does not heal existing damage when moved or grant additional slots. Drones excluded unless another card says otherwise.

source.originalText: Deployable Expertise: Your deployed devices have increased durability and effectiveness.

card.name: Remote Detonation
card.rangeAndTarget: Device within 60 ft, 10 ft radius up to 3 creatures
card.effect: Destroy your device; DEX save 2 S d6 force, half success. Failed save also no Reactions until end next turn. Cannot trigger Volatile Components/Scrap Reaper or another destruction/copy chain; no resource refund.

source.originalText: Remote Detonation: Detonate your devices remotely for area effect damage or stunning (level 9).

card.name: Deploy Sentry Turret
card.effect: Deploy Sentry engine profile: commanded attack range 25 ft PB+INT for 1d6 piercing. No auto fire, extra Bonus Action or shared budget exception. Durability AC 12+PB HP 2 L before upgrades.

source.originalText: Deploy Sentry Turret: Place an automated turret that fires at enemies (level 6).

card.name: Deploy Net Trap
card.effect: Deploy visible Net Trap. First enemy entry STR save or Restrained, repeat end turn or Action escape against DC. Target Huge+instead speed-10 ft. No damage or continued rearming; ends after one creature escapes.

source.originalText: Deploy Net Trap: Set a trap that roots enemies who trigger it (level 6).

card.name: Overcharge
card.effect: Next damaging activation adds S d6 to one target. One pending overcharge, no stacking, does not command device or grant attack. If device expires first cost lost.

source.originalText: Overcharge: Temporarily boost the effectiveness of one of your devices.

card.name: Recalibrate
card.rangeAndTarget: One drone; one visible enemy 60 ft
card.effect: Drone's next attack against chosen enemy has advantage. Still needs separate command; no automatic shot, enemy type wide permanent buff or crit conversion.

source.originalText: Recalibrate: Adjust your drone's targeting parameters to focus on a specific enemy type.

card.name: Emergency Protocols
card.rangeAndTarget: Drone within 10 ft when attack hits you
card.effect: Drone intercepts: reduce damage to you by S+M and takes same amount unmitigated. It must be active/conscious. Does not redirect again or trigger retaliation loops.

source.originalText: Emergency Protocols: Your drone automatically intercepts an attack meant for you once per encounter.

card.name: Protective Programming
card.rangeAndTarget: Drone adjacent to ally hit by attack
card.effect: Drone grants ally S+M temporary HP before hit resolves. No heal or reversal of hit; max one protected ally, normal temporary HP nonstacking.

source.originalText: Protective Programming: Your drone prioritizes defending vulnerable allies.

card.name: Efficient Power Cells
card.effect: A 3 round device lasts 4 rounds (50%rounded down). Healing pulse count unchanged, no extra ammunition or free commands. Does not extend spell concentration.

source.originalText: Efficient Power Cells: Your devices last 50% longer before needing recharging.

card.name: Nano-Aegis Drone
card.effect: Replace bolts with support mode. Each Bonus Action command pay 1 RP choose one ally 30 ft to heal S d6+M or grant 2 S+Mtemp HP. Maximum 3 pulses; organic healing explicit exception, no attack during mode.

source.originalText: Nano-Aegis Drone: Replace your combat drone with a healing/shield drone that protects allies.

card.name: Repair Pulse
card.duration: Instant; AC until start next turn
card.effect: Restore each half its maximum HP rounded down and+1 AC. Functional devices only; no construct resurrection, organic HP, resource or use resets.

source.originalText: Repair Pulse: Heal all drones, turrets, and party deployables for 50% HP and grant +1 AC to nearby allies.

card.name: Restoration Field
card.cost: 3 RP start; 1 RP maintenance; one slot
card.effect: Concentration. Initial and paid Bonus Action pulse heals up to 3 living allies/devices S d6 HP. Devices must not be destroyed. Same creature once/round, no extra autonomous healing or longer Efficient Cells.

source.originalText: Restoration Field: Create an area that gradually repairs mechanical devices and heals organic allies.

card.name: Overload Suppression
card.effect: CON save or fails its next Reaction and has disadvantage on attacks. On failure by 5 also Stunned, shared hard-denial guard. No automatic permanent deactivation, hacking allegiance or ignoring boss immunity.

source.originalText: Overload Suppression: Temporarily disable enemy mechanical devices or constructs.

card.name: Automated Field Kit
card.effect: Bomb stock cap/refill+1; encounter allowance unchanged. Reduce deployable card recharge by 1 minimum 1, on setting counter only. Never refresh rest uses or trigger repeated counter reductions.

source.originalText: Automated Field Kit: Carry an extra bomb and reduce deployable cooldowns by 1 round.

card.name: Enhanced Targeting
card.effect: Gain+1 to hit. Does not stack with Enhanced Drone Control if profile ever counts both, and does not impose save penalties.

source.originalText: Enhanced Targeting: Your turrets gain +1 to hit.

card.name: Efficient Recycling
card.effect: Recover 1 RP spent on deploying it, never more than its actual paid cost. Deliberate sacrifice or copy does not qualify. Consume usable debris; no repeated salvage from same object.

source.originalText: Efficient Recycling: Recover components from destroyed devices to create new ones.

card.name: Technical Mastery
card.effect: After damage rolld 10; on 10 you may pay 1 RP to add half its unmodified damage dice total rounded down to one target. No second activation, commands, procs, resources or healing duplication.

source.originalText: Technical Mastery: Your devices have a 10% chance to function twice when activated.

card.name: Advanced Turret Bay
card.rangeAndTarget: Two empty ground spaces within 15 ft
card.effect: Requires 2 available slots (normally 13); if only one, deploy one for 2 RP. Sniper command attack 90 ft S d6 piercing; Burst command DEX save S d4 piercing to 2 targets within 5 ftat 30 ft. One commanded turret per Bonus Action, not both automatically.

source.originalText: Advanced Turret Bay: Deploy two turrets simultaneously in either Sniper or Burst mode.

card.name: Gadget Sync Protocol
card.rangeAndTarget: One turret within 60 ft after your bomb throw
card.effect: Turret makes one ordinary shot at surviving bomb target. Replaces its normal commanded damaging action for that turn; cannot combine with another device attack from Bonus Action. No chains or additional bombs.

source.originalText: Gadget Sync Protocol: When you throw a bomb, one turret may fire instantly at the same target.

card.name: Snap Rebuild
card.effect: Restore half its maximum HP. Uses original slot and original expiry; expired devices ineligible. Does not reset limited uses, modules, Overdrive, destruction triggers or bomb stock.

source.originalText: Snap Rebuild: Once per encounter, instantly redeploy any destroyed turret or pet with 50% HP.

card.name: Reconfiguration
card.effect: Change between known nonhealing profiles using same HP fraction, slot, expiry and spent uses. Cannot turn a 1 slot device into two, refill ammo, reset trap, create fresh death trigger or morph drone into free bomb.

source.originalText: Reconfiguration: Transform one deployed device into another type.

card.name: Malfunction Field
card.rangeAndTarget: Enemy within 5 ft of your device
card.effect: First spell attack by one enemy has disadvantage. Multiple devices do not multiply effect; area/spell-saves unchanged. Does not create antimagic zone.

source.originalText: Malfunction Field: Enemies near your devices must roll twice on spell attacks and take the lower result.

card.name: Volatile Components
card.rangeAndTarget: One device destroyed by enemy; one enemy within 5 ft
card.effect: Deal S fire to that enemy. Deliberate sacrifices, copied objects, friendly damage and secondary explosions cannot trigger. No other procs/resources from damage.

source.originalText: Volatile Components: Your devices explode when destroyed, damaging nearby enemies.

card.name: Scrap Salvage
card.rangeAndTarget: Empty space within 5 ft of debris
card.effect: Create one Scrapling AC 12 HP L Speed 20 ft, commanded melee attack PB+INT for 1d6 bludgeoning. Counts as deployable slot/shared command. Consumed debris cannot be salvaged again; cannot spawn its own replacement.

source.originalText: Scrap Salvage: Create temporary minions from destroyed devices.

card.name: Boomcore Drone
card.effect: Commanded bolts add 1d6 fire and on hit STR save or push 5 ft. Still one command and normal attack budget; no free activation attack or unlimited stacking.

source.originalText: Boomcore Drone: Upgrade your drone to use blast bolts that deal damage and knockback.

card.name: Scrap Reaper
card.effect: Create one Scrapling Speed 30, AC 12 HP L; next Bonus Action command moves and detonates within 5 ft one enemy for 2 S d6 fire DEX half. Uses one command budget and ends. No chain from deliberate sacrifice or its own death.

source.originalText: Scrap Reaper: When a turret or drone dies, summon a Scrapling that chases and explodes on enemies.

card.name: Volatile Injection
card.effect: Must have strictly more HP than cost. Its next damaging activation adds S d6 to one target; cannot combine with Overcharge, damage cannot be refunded by same activation. No resources gained from self damage.

source.originalText: Volatile Injection: Temporarily boost a device's power at the cost of stability.

card.name: Catastrophic Overload
card.rangeAndTarget: 10 ft radius about device within 60 ft
card.effect: All creatures including allies DEX save, 3 S d6 fire plus 3 S d6 force on failure, half success. No critical hit, additional destruction proc, salvage, automatic stun or copied damage. Device ends before blast; no Safety exclusion.

source.originalText: Catastrophic Overload: Sacrifice a device for a massive explosion that damages all nearby creatures.

card.name: Mech Overdrive
card.cost: 1 long-rest use plus original deployment cost
card.rangeAndTarget: One of your newly deployed devices
card.effect: Source-derived level 20 feature: extend device duration only. It still occupies its slot, requires normal commands and payments, and is destructible. Healing devices keep maximum 3 pulses; bombs, spent uses and expended charges never refill. Does not create permanent equipment.

source.originalText: You begin with one deployable slot and gain additional slots as you level up. At level 20, you gain Mech Overdrive, allowing one device to become permanent for the duration of a battle.

card.name: Magnetic Wall
card.effect: AC 12+PB HP 2 L, blocks LOS/movement. Reaction when ranged weapon hit ally within 5 ft of wall reduce its damage by S+M and wall takes reduction amount. Requires line between attack and wall; no automatic all-shot absorption.

source.originalText: Magnetic Wall: Deploy a barrier that pulls ranged attacks into it and provides cover.

classRecords.candidateOrigin: Semantic supplement: operational wall interception text lacks lexical device/deploy/redirect terms.

supportingSources.paragraphPrefix: Where a class card calls for a
supportingSources.text: Where a class card calls for a **standard companion** without a more specific profile, use: Small or Medium; AC 12+floor(PB/2); HP 2 L; walking Speed 30 ft; saves equal owner's PB; one melee or ranged attack (reach 5 ft/range 30 ft) at owner's class attack bonus, damage S d6 of the printed type. It has no independent class features, resources, loot, death triggers or extra turns. All companions belonging to one character share one Bonus Action command and **one damaging attack/action total per round** unless a specifically priced feature grants more. Without a command they move and Dodge. Act immediately after owner. A standard companion lasts 1 minute, disappears at 0 HP and cannot be healed for free by dismissing/resummoning. The creation cost must be paid again. Creature-specific stat blocks override this profile only where explicitly printed.

One regular Action, one Bonus Action if a feature permits it, normal movement and one Reaction between starts of your turns. A free trigger costs no Action only if expressly stated. All grants share **one extra full Action per creature per round**. An extra Action cannot grant another Action, recharge itself, or start another extra-Action grant. It supplies no extra Bonus Action or Reaction. A card granting additional attacks is not permission to repeat all class riders on every hit: obey each rider's frequency.

No damage/healing copy repeats the source's costs, procs, resource generation, critical bonus dice, buffs, actions, cooldown resets or duration. Compute fractions once, capped at 100% of one stored source unless an explicit card states a separately priced higher amount. Copies still cause ordinary damage consequences, concentration checks and death. A copy cannot copy another copy. A target/source record must refer to an actual resolved event, not merely a known ability name.
